correctness.rationale: From the explicit poset relations, every linear extension is a product of disjoint allowed adjacent swaps; these are exactly matchings, with the descent number equal to matching cardinality. The Stanley binomial expansion gives Omega(t)=sum_k m_k binom(t+n-1-k,n). Differentiation yields [t]Omega=(1/n!)sum_k(-1)^k m_k k!(n-1-k)!. Removing one distinguished edge from a (k+1)-matching proves (k+1)m_{k+1}<=(n-1-k)m_k, and hence the alternating magnitudes decrease. All induced subposets (in particular ideals/filters) reindex within the same family, so Ferroni–Morales–Panova Theorem 3.4 applies to all coefficients. Shifting t->t+1 gives strict Ehrhart positivity. Independent permutation enumeration and direct matching-polynomial comparison checked 127 (n,E) cases through n=7, with 896 factorial-scaled coefficients and exact zero-linear cases (2,1),(3,3); this is corroboration, not the universal proof.

originality.rationale: Theorem 3.4 in Ferroni–Morales–Panova is a hereditary reduction, not a universal width-two positivity statement; their Section 7.1 explicitly conjectures width-two positivity, while their proven skew cell poset and fence cases are different definitions. The result constructs the required missing positive linear coefficient for the path-incomparability family, so it is not simply an application absent a new check.
residual_risks: Possible older equivalent proof for naturally labeled unit-interval orders or complements of path incomparability graphs under alternative nomenclature not located by bounded search.
